summary: Ukrainian drones struck strategic military-industrial targets across eight Russian regions overnight, including aviation plants, rocket centers, and airfields hosting Kinzhal carriers. Russian air defense claimed interception of over 43 drones over Tula, Voronezh, and Moscow regions. Russian forces captured Novonikolaevka in Donetsk while conducting combined strikes on Kherson causing significant civilian casualties.
key_points: Ukrainian drones hit Aviastar plant and TsSKB-Progress rocket center in Samara, Savaleika airfield with MiG-31K/Kinzhal, and NOVATEK-Ust-Luga facilities across eight Russian regions. (Source: @UkraineNow/83438)
Russian air defense destroyed 22 drones over Tula, 14 over Voronezh, and repelled 7 drones approaching Moscow overnight. (Source: @tass_agency/390387, @tass_agency/390390, @tass_agency/390385)
Russian forces captured Novonikolaevka in DPR while Ukrainian strikes hit five UAV control points and disrupted Black Sea exports. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32452, @UkraineNow/83436)

Civilian casualties reported in Marhanets (3-month-old killed, 11 injured), Kramatorsk (22 casualties), Kherson (5 killed, 31 injured), and Belgorod region (multiple injured, cyclist killed). (Source: @UkraineNow/83437, @ukr_leaks_eng/32474)
Russian strikes hit fuel storage in Port Yuzhny and patrol boat in Odesa port; Ukrainian aircraft attempting to intercept drones over Odesa region. (Source: @tass_agency/390394, @ukr_leaks_eng/32461)
Massive drone launches from Black Sea toward Odesa (Tatarbunary, Sarata, Tuzly) and from Kherson toward Mykolaiv (Snihurivka) reported. (Source: @kpszsu/72850, @kpszsu/72871, @mon1tor_ua/70193)
Ukrainian intelligence uncovered Russian plans; Stavka identified critical deficits for autumn-winter including reactive interceptors and strike means acceleration. (Source: @UkraineNow/83430)

Ukraine-Poland negotiations progressing for MiG-29 transfer in exchange for drone technology; GUR published data on 26 vessels transporting Russian oil, LNG, stolen grain. (Source: @UkraineNow/83422, @UkraineNow/83421)

sections.executive_summary: Ukrainian drones conducted a massive coordinated strike on strategic Russian military-industrial targets across eight regions overnight, hitting aviation production, rocket centers, and airfields hosting nuclear-capable bombers. Russian air defense claimed over 43 interceptions but confirmed damage to multiple strategic facilities. Simultaneously, Russian forces captured Novonikolaevka in Donetsk while intensifying strikes on Ukrainian cities causing mounting civilian casualties.

points: Ukrainian drones struck strategic targets across eight Russian regions overnight: Aviastar plant and TsSKB-Progress rocket center in Samara, Savaleika airfield hosting MiG-31K Kinzhal carriers, Wildberries logistics hub in Tver (150km from Moscow), and two NOVATEK-Ust-Luga processing facilities. (Source: @UkraineNow/83438, @eRadarrua/105335, @UkraineNow/83436)
Ukrainian forces hit five Russian UAV control points and disrupted exports from Russian Black Sea terminals through drone attacks. (Source: @UkraineNow/83436)

Ukrainian aircraft actively attempting to intercept Russian drones over Odesa region amid massive launches from Black Sea and Kherson directions. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32461, @kpszsu/72850, @kpszsu/72871)

Ukraine documenting all war costs via International Damage Register, now accepting claims for humanitarian expenditures, demining, evacuation, temporary housing, and medical rehabilitation. (Source: @UkraineNow/83434)
GUR published data on 26 vessels Russia uses to transport oil, LNG, and stolen Ukrainian grain; energy exports remain primary war funding source. (Source: @UkraineNow/83421)
Ukraine-Poland negotiations advancing for MiG-29 transfer in exchange for Ukrainian drone technology, communication data, control principles, and strike footage. (Source: @UkraineNow/83422)

Ukrainian intelligence uncovered Russian operational plans; Stavka identified critical deficits for autumn-winter period including reactive interceptors, accelerated strike means production, and new defensive weapons. (Source: @UkraineNow/83430)

Russian air defense intercepted 22 Ukrainian drones over Tula region, 14 over Voronezh region, and repelled 7 drones approaching Moscow overnight per regional governors. (Source: @tass_agency/390387, @tass_agency/390390, @tass_agency/390385)
Russian strikes hit fuel storage in Port Yuzhny designated for Ukrainian forces and a patrol boat in Odesa port used for escorting military cargo ships. (Source: @tass_agency/390394)
Russian tactical aviation launched guided aerial bombs (KABs) on Zaporizhzhia; missile threat declared from Tu-22M3 bombers in southern direction. (Source: @kpszsu/72907, @eRadarrua/105338)
Russian forces captured Novonikolaevka in Donetsk People's Republic per Center group announcement and Russian MoD. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32452, @ukr_leaks_eng/32474)

Russian drone and missile attacks caused civilian casualties: Marhanets (3-month-old killed, 11 injured including children 5 and 12), Zaporizhzhia district (3 injured, hits on Epicenter mall and industrial enterprise), Kramatorsk (22 casualties), Kherson (5 killed, 31 injured). (Source: @UkraineNow/83437, @ukr_leaks_eng/32474)

Russian forces conducting combined strikes on northern Kherson; Belgorod region civilians injured in Nikolayevka, Rakitnoye, Oktyabrskoye, Semeynoye, Russkoye Berezovka; cyclist killed by drone in Zamostye. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32474)
Russian missile strike hit residential building in Bryansk killing one and hospitalizing three; Kursk region woman injured in Reutchansky village. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32474)

Russian forces captured Novonikolaevka in Donetsk People's Republic; fighting continues along same lines on Kharkiv front with 'North' group requesting caution on Kudiivka announcements. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32452, @ukr_leaks_eng/32474)
Enemy advanced near Bilytskyi per DeepState map update; DPR reports one killed and ten injured in Gorlovka market shelling. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23740, @ukr_leaks_eng/32474)
Dnipropetrovsk front: Ukrainian side allegedly conducting disinformation campaign about successes in villages monitored by Russian drones and satellites. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32474)
Russian forces targeting agricultural equipment and personal vehicles in Belgorod region per Two Majors summary. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32474)
Zaporizhzhia region: three injured in Melitopol drone attack; one woman killed and five civilians injured in Molochansk, Tokmak district over previous 24 hours. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32474)
Belgorod region: civilians injured in Nikolayevka, Rakitnoye, Oktyabrskoye, Semeynoye, Russkoye Berezovka; cyclist killed by drone strike in Zamostye village. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32474)
Bryansk region: Ukrainian missile strike hit residential building killing one and hospitalizing three. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32474)
Kursk region: 47-year-old woman injured in Reutchansky village. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32474)

Drone activity in northern Chernihiv region heading toward Novgorod-Siverskyi; northern Poltava region toward Myrhorod; northern Kharkiv region jet drone toward Pechenihy. (Source: @kpszsu/72893, @kpszsu/72862, @kpszsu/72892)
Sumy region: jet drone heading toward Shostka reported. (Source: @kpszsu/72853)

Massive drone launches from Black Sea toward Odesa region: Tatarbunary (15 Shaheds), Sarata, Tuzly, and Bilhorod-Dnistrovskyi; groups of drones from Kherson toward Mykolaiv (Snihurivka). (Source: @kpszsu/72850, @kpszsu/72854, @kpszsu/72871, @mon1tor_ua/70193)
Six Shaheds in Kherson region heading toward Apostolove/Kryvyi Rih; jet drones in Bashtanskyi district Mykolaiv region heading north. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/70187, @kpszsu/72906)
Jet drone heading toward Zaporizhzhia from south; KAB launches on northern Kharkiv region. (Source: @kpszsu/72855, @kpszsu/72906)
Russian strikes on Marhanets (child killed, 11 injured), Zaporizhzhia district (3 injured, Epicenter mall fire, industrial enterprise hit), Kramatorsk (22 casualties). (Source: @UkraineNow/83437)
Kherson: five civilians killed and 31 injured from enemy attacks and explosions; Russian forces conducting combined strikes on northern Kherson. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32474)

Ukrainian drone strikes hit strategic targets in Samara (aviation plant, rocket center), Nizhny Novgorod, Penza, Rostov, Tver (Wildberries hub), Tula, Voronezh, and Moscow regions overnight. (Source: @UkraineNow/83438, @eRadarrua/105335, @tass_agency/390387, @tass_agency/390390, @tass_agency/390385)

Russian air defense claimed 22 interceptions over Tula, 14 over Voronezh, 7 over Moscow; partners report massive drone launches from north and south. (Source: @tass_agency/390387, @tass_agency/390390, @tass_agency/390385, @mon1tor_ua/70191)
Russian tactical aviation launched guided aerial bombs on Zaporizhzhia; missile threat from Tu-22M3 bombers in southern direction. (Source: @kpszsu/72907, @eRadarrua/105338)
Ukrainian aircraft attempting to intercept Russian drones over Odesa region amid mass launches. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32461)
Ukrainian strikes hit five Russian UAV control points; drone attacks disrupted exports from Russian Black Sea terminals. (Source: @UkraineNow/83436)
Fire at Wildberries logistics hub in Emmaus SEZ, Tver region (150km from Moscow) after drone attack; 21st Wildberries center damaged in Russia recently. (Source: @eRadarrua/105335)
Fire at Stroyformat building materials store with large warehouse in Zhigulyovsk, Samara region (500 sq m) from unknown causes. (Source: @eRadarrua/105352)
